## About
New Generation Exteriors Corp. was founded by Francisco Ruiz, who has always been passionate about the roofing industry. We started strictly as a roofing contractor, and with the support of our customers we grew into siding, gutters and storm damage repairs.
We listen first, so we understand your concerns and can meet your expectations. Most of our business comes from referrals from current and past customers, and we want to keep earning that trust one house at a time.
Get in touch and tell us what your home or building needs. We look forward to working with you.

## Services
- Roofing: Commercial and residential roofing, installed so you can feel safe and secure when a severe storm rolls through.
- Storm damage repairs: Repairs to roofs and exteriors after storm damage.
- Siding: New siding to improve the value and curb appeal of your home, in vinyl, fiber cement or wood.
- Gutters: Properly installed gutters and downspouts that keep your home drier and give you better water control.
- Soffit and fascia: Soffits and fascia sit closest to the gutters, so they are often the first to suffer water damage when gutters clog. We repair and replace them.
- Skylights: VELUX skylights to bring more sunlight and interest into your home.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on commercial buildings or just homes?
A: Both. We do commercial and residential roofing.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Give us a call or send a message through our contact form to get a free quote.

Q: What kinds of siding do you install?
A: The three main types of residential siding are vinyl, fiber cement and wood. We can help you weigh which fits your home.
